plugin.name: Better Termix
plugin.description: Small UI fixes and an optional terminal input fix: hide host IPs, show host status, stop the white flash on reload and add an interface size.

bootPatch.label: Stop the white flash on reload
bootPatch.description: Adds a small script to Termix's index.html so your theme shows before the app loads. It edits a Termix file on the server and is undone when you turn this off or disable the plugin.

bootPatchDir.label: Frontend folder
bootPatchDir.description: The folder that holds Termix's index.html. Leave empty to find it on its own (/app/html in Docker).

terminalInputFix.label: Fix disappearing text while editing terminal input
terminalInputFix.description: Disables predictive local echo in SSH Terminal for all users to avoid overwritten or missing text when inserting in the middle of a line. Edits its frontend file on the server; turning this off or disabling Better Termix restores it. Reload the page and reconnect terminals after changing this.

terminalFrontendFile.label: SSH Terminal frontend file
terminalFrontendFile.description: Leave empty to find the bundled SSH Terminal automatically. Set the full path to its dist/frontend.js if Termix is installed elsewhere.

hideIp.label: Hide host IP addresses
hideIp.description: Hides the IP next to each host in the dashboard's Host Status list and pinned hosts. Only the display changes; connections keep using the IP.

statusNames.label: Show host status in the sidebar
statusNames.description: Shows whether each host in the sidebar is online or offline.

statusStyle.label: Status style
statusStyle.description: How the status is shown next to each host name.
statusStyle.name: Color the name

mediumSize.label: Use a size between Normal and Large
mediumSize.description: Overrides the interface size picked in Appearance.
